name: Inma Seifuku Gari
source:
A demon is playing the "hunt down the woman and molest her in any way humanly and inhumanly possible" game. However, there is more to that demon than meets the eye. Will the true face of the demon be revealed?

(from [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=833]AniDB[/url])
translation:
一名恶魔正在玩一场“追猎女人，并用人类乃至非人类所能想到的一切方式猥亵她”的游戏。然而，这名恶魔并不像表面看起来那么简单。它的真面目最终会揭晓吗？

（摘自[url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=833]AniDB[/url]）
